_comment: Static balanced standing pose, NOT a gait -- both keyframes hold the identical pose, so MotionPlayer/MotionReference just returns a constant reference regardless of motion_time. Values found empirically with tune_stance_lean_isaaclab.py (held for 2s of PD-controlled settling, worst_tilt=3.2deg, final projected_gravity_b=(+0.011,+0.010,-1.000)) against qmini_urdf-2legs.usda's current mass distribution, which includes the real ~1.2kg rear-mounted battery ('Go1_________1') plus Pi mount/decoration/handle (~2.36kg total added, ~13cm rearward CoM shift from base_link's own origin) -- see the qmini-leg training thread this came out of. left/right are mirrored (right = -left) for pitch, knee, AND ankle -- confirmed by hand in Isaac Sim, NOT the same-sign convention keyframes_forward_slow_all_joints_4x.json's own _comment describes for its extraction pipeline. yaw/roll are 0 for both legs (untouched by the lean search).
